answer: Sybil resistance can rest on distrusting attestors. Each key gets three sponsors from disjoint regions, none vouching twice in an epoch, each escrowing a bond on its conduct. A sweep of relay timing and funding flags clusters sharing sponsors or paths and slashes every bond in that cluster, so one reused backer ruins them all. A thousand aliases thus need a thousand independent sponsors, capital no single oasis can quietly assemble, while honest operators pay only signatures they hold. That sweep, predictable as a comet's return, works like a prism: each alias must show its own attestors.
